summary: American Rebel Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement and a $155,294.12 promissory note with Quick Capital, LLC. The note includes a $23,294.12 original issue discount and $7,000 in lender legal fees, netting $132,000 in proceeds. It bears a one-time interest charge of $29,117.65 (18.75% guaranteed interest) and is payable in 15 equal monthly installments from July 2026 to September 2027. No warrants are attached. The company intends to use proceeds for general working capital. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
